title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25
source: SBD Master Reel > ? > DAT > CD-R > EAC (secure) > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with smoking Dark Star, Mind Left Body Jam and Let It Grow>GDTRFB; soundboard source is decent but a bit thin.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the improvisational peaks – a delicate, spacey Dark Star, a monster Mind Left Body Jam, tight Playing In The Band and an inspiring Let It Grow into GDTRFB. The recording (identified as a sound‑board) is generally clear enough to enjoy, though several listeners note it sounds a little thin compared with classic tapes.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (6/7) are 5‑star and praise the musical performance; only one mentions thin sound and another gives a modest 3‑star, yielding an overall strong rating with high confidence due to multiple detailed comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard capture but described as a bit thin; no major dropouts or balance issues reported.

standout_songs: Let It Grow > Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as a free‑flowing, liberating jam; first set considered slower by at least one reviewer but overall pacing praised for its improvisational peaks.
